title: Container diagram for rustinfer
intro: The separately runnable or storing units inside rustinfer, and the stores and devices it touches. A container with components opens its component view.

containers.name: rustinfer CLI
containers.desc: The one command: build, inspect, run, tune; bench from R2, serve from R3.

containers.name: rustinfer library
containers.desc: The engine as a library: compile a checkpoint, load an artifact, enqueue requests and await responses.

containers.name: HTTP server
containers.desc: OpenAI-shaped completions over HTTP, with metrics for Prometheus.

containers.name: GPU device boundary
containers.desc: Where host memory ends: device buffers, streams, events and the loaded code objects.

stores.name: .rie artifact
stores.desc: A cache: the Plan, the kernels and the weight manifest, hashed and bound to the checkpoint's identity.

stores.name: Tuning catalog
stores.desc: The autotuner's measured choices, a cache independent of any artifact (RI-ART-010).

stores.name: Checkpoint directory
stores.desc: The model as published; read in place.

relations.label: writes once, reads and verifies on load
